phase: Phase 7.0c — generic-compressor baseline ladder: compare complete files against raw source, gzip, zstd, xz, brotli, whole-file byte rANS and the best VOLE structural candidate
dirty_note: No tracked modifications and no src/wire/candidate change at measurement time (binary_sha256 matches the Phase-7.0b producers campaign exactly). Only new tooling/evidence files are untracked: tools/baselines.sh, tools/baselines.jq, tools/baselines-merge.jq, tools/baselines-table.jq and the receipt this campaign adds.
baseline_stage_from: dev (same pinned base digest as the measurement toolchain)
commands: docker compose run --rm --no-TTY dev cargo build --locked --all-features
docker compose run --rm --no-TTY -e BASELINE_CORPUS=phase7 baseline sh tools/baselines.sh evidence/campaigns/2026-10-05-phase7-baselines-7b9f662/phase7-baselines.json evidence/corpus/phase7

docker compose run --rm --no-TTY -e BASELINE_CORPUS=producers baseline sh tools/baselines.sh evidence/campaigns/2026-10-05-phase7-baselines-7b9f662/producers-baselines.json evidence/corpus/phase7-producers
docker compose run --rm --no-TTY baseline sh -c 'jq -s -f tools/baselines-merge.jq <phase7> <producers> > results.json'
docker compose run --rm --no-TTY baseline sh -c 'jq -r -f tools/baselines-table.jq results.json > baseline-table.md'
method: For every file in the two locally generated corpora: source size; the smallest lossless complete-file size for gzip -9, zstd -19 --long=27, xz -9e and brotli -q 11 (each round-trip verified by decompressing and byte-comparing against the source before it is scored); and the complete serialized .voldoc size of every VOLE lane — the unforced auto winner plus forced raw, rle, byte-rans, pdf-physical, pdf-channels, pdf-layout, pdf-layout-rans, pdf-deflate-replay and pdf-deflate-replay-rans. A forced kind the input does not propose is a typed Usage decline, recorded null. `best_vole` is the minimum across all VOLE lanes, so it is the most favourable VOLE number. Every auto winner is verify'd and decode|cmp'd byte-exact.

corpora.phase7: evidence/corpus/phase7 (11 produced + 11 synthetic + 1 non-PDF control), locally generated by tools/pdf-corpus.sh
corpora.producers: evidence/corpus/phase7-producers (ReportLab, Cairo, LibreOffice, pdfTeX), locally generated by tools/pdf-corpus-producers.sh

roundtrip: All 27 auto winners verify_ok + roundtrip_ok byte-exact; every generic compressor result is round-trip verified before scoring.
